summary: varint_size(0) returned 0, underestimating POSTCARD_MAX_SIZE for zero-capacity heapless vectors and strings: their serialized length prefix requires one byte. The fix returns 1 for zero. The existing tests/max_size.rs test_vec_edge_cases test gains a zero-capacity case in this commit that compares POSTCARD_MAX_SIZE with the serialized length. The proposed reversal removes only the guard, exactly restoring the parent implementation. No tests were run.
